units.unit_name: The Green River drained eastward through Wyoming until late Miocene time about 6 m.y. ago when it overtopped the Uinta crest to drain southward, cutting Lodore Canyon and joing the Colorado River in southeastern Utah. All landscape features in Dinosaur Monument have been carved during the last 6 million years (Hansen, 1986a)
